message: Two candidate answers undergo the same check. Both fail. Instead of selecting a winner, the assistant sends the answers to a person for review.
audience: People learning how AI answer checking and human review can work
claims: Two candidate answers receive the same check.
The assistant sends both answers to a person for review.
illustrative_assumptions: The check is staged as an identical tactile link stencil revealing route gaps.
The answers are labeled A and B.
An arena setting visually represents comparison and review.
Answers A and B are already positioned with identical geometry when the scene opens.
ending_action: Both failed answer sheets finish moving into a separate person's receiving hand and remain there for review, with no winner shown.

beats.subject: Answers A and B
beats.action: The bot presents two already aligned, untested answer sheets.
beats.before_after: Before: the bot is neutral beside the aligned sheets. After: the bot presents A and B as the candidates.
beats.focal_detail: Two untested answer sheets shown side by side with identical geometry.
beats.consequence: Both candidates are introduced without claiming the check has occurred.
beats.narration: Here are answers A and B.
beats.caption: Meet A and B
beats.headline: Two answers

beats.subject: Answer A
beats.action: The stencil lands on A, exposes a missing route connection, and registers a cross.
beats.before_after: Before: A is untested. After: A shows a visible route gap and fail cross.
beats.focal_detail: A's broken route beneath the tactile stencil.
beats.narration: Checking A reveals a route gap before its cross appears.
beats.caption: Checking answer A

beats.subject: Answer B
beats.action: The identical stencil lands on B with matching geometry, exposes its route gap, and registers a cross.
beats.before_after: Before: B is untested while A is failed. After: B also shows a visible route gap and fail cross.
beats.focal_detail: The same stencil and framing used for A exposing B's broken route.
beats.consequence: Both candidates have now undergone the same physical check.
beats.narration: Checking B with the same stencil reveals its gap before the cross.
beats.caption: Checking answer B
beats.headline: Same check

beats.subject: Both failed answers
beats.action: Both crossed sheets remain side by side for a clear result hold.
beats.before_after: Before: B's check has just completed. After: both route gaps and both crosses remain plainly visible.
beats.focal_detail: Matching failed sheets with no winner marker anywhere in frame.
beats.consequence: The shared outcome is established before review begins.
beats.narration: Both answers failed the same check.
beats.caption: Both answers failed
beats.headline: Both failed

beats.subject: Both failed answers
beats.action: Both marked sheets travel together into a separate person's receiving hand and remain there.
beats.before_after: Before: both failed sheets rest in the arena with no winner. After: a person holds both for review, still with no winner.
beats.focal_detail: The receiving human hand holding both crossed answer sheets.
beats.consequence: Human review begins without automatic selection.
beats.narration: No winner; both go to a person for review.
beats.caption: To a person
beats.headline: Human review
